The Best New NYC Steakhouse Comes From Argentina

blocks.x: The highly regarded Argentinian restaurateur Pablo Rivero has teamed up with Alex and Adam Saper (the brothers behind Eataly) to open Rivero’s first restaurant outside Argentina, Graciela, in July. The tavern’s centerpiece is a parrilla and Spanish Josper oven, spanning more than ten feet of live-fire cooking. Look for starters like roasted red pepper or eggplant dips, morcilla and eggs, a chickpea tart, Sasso chicken, rib-eye, short ribs, and more. It’s a small space, so get cozy and don’t forget to say hi to the cute shrimp lantern.
